intro: Boat and auto detailing in Canyon Lake, with ceramic coating for the finish. Dustin is a local, a fellow enthusiast and a Marine Certified Detailer.
servicesIntro: From a wash and wax to full restoration, teak and ceramic coating.

services.name: Full Exterior w/Heavy Oxidation
services.text: Thorough wash, deep cleaning, and intensive compounding and polishing to bring faded gel coat back to a deep, glossy shine.

services.name: Full Exterior
services.text: Removes dirt, grime and water spots, then protects the surface to enhance shine and revive the finish.

services.name: Standard Interior
services.text: Deep cleaning that removes dirt, stains, mold and mildew, leaving the boat fresh and ready for the water.

services.name: Auto Detailing
services.text: Maintenance, standard and full exterior details with multi-step paint correction, plus maintenance and standard interior details.

services.name: Boat Ceramic Coating
services.text: A durable, high-gloss, hydrophobic barrier for the exterior, interior, compartments, fish boxes and live wells.

services.name: Auto Ceramic Coating
services.text: Coating for exterior paint, glass, wheels, interior and seats, to repel water and dirt and protect against UV.

why.name: Trained and certified
why.text: Detailers are trained through the International Detailers Association, and Dustin is a Marine Certified Detailer.

why.name: Marine safe products
why.text: Biodegradable, marine safe chemicals, and a shop lit to show every imperfection.

why.name: A local enthusiast
why.text: Dustin lives on Canyon Lake and cares for your boat or car like his own.
